name: jjui-contextual-action-palette-for-stacked-views
instr:
jjui cannot currently show which actions the active stacked view can execute. Add a contextual action palette over the current view with filtering and navigation; invocation must match ordinary dispatch.

The catalog must deterministically derive action identity, scope, description, required arguments, and deduplicated configured binding labels from authoritative metadata. Entries distinguish `ActionUnavailable`, `ActionReady`, and `ActionNeedsArguments`. Readiness requires successful resolution and consumption by the visible scope chain in the current model state.

Availability across annotation, bookmarks, choose, diff, command history, git, and help must follow every live substate that makes direct dispatch meaningful or a no-op. Applying an entry must preserve direct-dispatch messages, mutations, asynchronous commands, rendering, and transitions. `ActionEntry`, `Catalog`, `Observer`, and `Session` provide enumeration, non-executing resolution observation, refreshable snapshots, and application through normal routing.

Configured Lua overrides retain ordinary precedence; explicit built-ins bypass them as existing built-in dispatch does. Revalidate ready entries and dispatch exactly once. Stale or invalid entries issue no command and return `ErrActionUnavailable`, exactly `errors.New("action unavailable")`.
